title: Ordinary-person generality and regenerative-loop audit for intergenerational value translation
purpose: Test whether LWA-VALUE-TRANSLATION is broad enough to involve ordinary retired adults, whether youth/digital translators have durable incentives, how value capture differs by subtype, and whether successful translation naturally replenishes the next source asset.
truth_rules: LARGE OLDER POPULATION != LARGE MONETIZABLE ASSET POOL
AI CAN SUBSTITUTE PART OF TRANSLATION
VALUE CAPTURE DIRECTION MUST BE EXPLICIT

evidence.fact: Fengtai's 2026 Silver Workshop has expanded to 38 community pilots with nearly 200 older artisans/retired experts in its talent pool, covering both craft and retired-engineer knowledge.
evidence.interpretation: This is not celebrity-only supply; ordinary community-level discovery can surface a non-trivial pool of latent capability.

evidence.fact: The Fudan young-team memoir project reached service agreements with about 30 older adults within roughly one year and completed eight long-form works.
evidence.interpretation: Life-story assets also appear repeatedly across ordinary older adults rather than only famous/public figures.

evidence.fact: A Hangzhou September 2026 pilot enrolled 20+ older learners attempting to turn accumulated cooking, family-education and other experience into AI Skills.
evidence.interpretation: Digital-callable experience is not limited to professional elites, but current evidence is still pilot-scale.

evidence.fact: One major web-fiction platform reports nearly 10,000 signed authors aged 50+, showing large-scale later-life conversion of accumulated life/local experience into digital cultural output, while commercial returns remain limited for many.
evidence.interpretation: The creation impulse and source-material pool are broad, but economic capture is not uniformly broad.

ordinary_person_generality.conclusion: The source pool is broader than masters/celebrities, but the share of older adults with translatable and economically valuable assets remains UNKNOWN.

evidence.fact: Fengtai explicitly uses community-level talent discovery, database building, pilots, recruitment and continued departmental sourcing to find new silver capability.

The Fudan project plans to grow through more eldercare-institution, street and community cooperation; current public reporting does not establish participant-to-participant referral as the dominant acquisition channel.
The Shaoxing basket model has lasted six years but depends on a community workshop plus university/community youth participation; longevity is proven, self-replenishing source acquisition is not.

acquisition_loop.conclusion: A regenerating older-adult source population exists demographically, but the actual discovery/acquisition function remains actively produced by institutions/organizers. Demand Pump at the source-discovery layer is not yet proven.

evidence.fact: The Fudan team converts humanistic/digital skills into a social-enterprise path; funding includes family service fees, institutional payments and donations, and the team explicitly seeks a sustainable replicable model.

The Shaoxing basket model uses young community workers and university volunteers for design, packaging, short video, livestream and sales; value creation is clear, but independent youth compensation is not publicly bound.
Policy-level discussion in 2026 explicitly frames young programmers, data analysts and designers as needed participants in silver-economy value co-creation.

youth_translator_incentive.conclusion: Young people can gain professional practice, portfolio, venture opportunity and potentially income, but public evidence does not yet establish a large independent pool willing to perform elder-asset translation under repeat commercial terms.

value_capture_split.name: Legacy / self-expression translation
value_capture_split.payer_direction: older adult / family / eldercare institution pays to preserve, structure or express older-adult assets

evidence.fact: Fudan reports family service fees and eldercare-institution payment support in addition to donations.
AI memoir services are now commercially offered; one current example prices two books plus one video at RMB2,800.

value_capture_split.formation_note: Value is created by making an elder's own memory/identity legible and durable; downstream market demand is not necessary for the asset to have value.
value_capture_split.risk: This can become a conventional customized service business with heavy bespoke labor and may not satisfy regenerative orchestration requirements.

value_capture_split.name: Market-utilization translation
value_capture_split.payer_direction: downstream consumer/audience/institution pays for a translated older-adult capability

evidence.fact: Shaoxing youth redesign/distribution increased reported basket value from roughly RMB6 to roughly RMB60 with demand exceeding supply.
Fengtai's Silver Workshop explicitly links older capability to markets and has expanded to markets, courses, online/offline sales and nearly 200 older participants.

value_capture_split.formation_note: The translated asset becomes useful to someone else and value is captured downstream.
value_capture_split.risk: Demand may be power-law, niche or category-specific; not every elder capability has an external market.

steps: elicit / extract / observe the embodied asset
structure and validate what is authentic/useful
select an appropriate modern value form
cross_form_translation_kernel.caution: This is a descriptive repeated grammar, not a proposed software workflow or business product.

evidence.fact: Hangzhou older participants can directly create AI Skills from their own accumulated experience, indicating AI may reduce the need for a younger human translator in some knowledge-translation cases.
AI memoir services use automation to lower transcription/writing/production cost, and multiple providers have already entered the category.

ai_substitution_contradiction.implication: The durable missing edge cannot simply be 'young people know digital tools'. Human youth may remain valuable for trust, elicitation, taste, contextual understanding, design and distribution, but those functions must be evidenced rather than assumed.

evidence.fact: The Fudan team explicitly describes fidelity to the elder's own understanding as a core quality standard and uses human interpretation where AI categorization loses narrative meaning.

rights_and_fidelity.implication: Translation is not simple content extraction. Consent, narrative fidelity, attribution, privacy, IP and revenue-sharing can be part of the missing edge.

next_action: Discriminate VT-A versus VT-B at repeatability/orchestration level. Search which value-capture direction can become a broad repeated system without bespoke founder labor: recurrent source discovery, reusable translation units, replaceable younger/digital translators, clear rights/acceptance, repeat/referral acquisition and observable willingness to pay. Do not choose memoir/craft/creator/AI Skill as the product. Kill any subtype that remains custom-service, grant-driven or power-law.
